explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1002: f(α,n)=(1/log n)Σ_{1≤k≤n}(1/2-{αk}); is there non-decreasing g with g(-∞)=0, g(∞)=1 and |{α∈(0,1): f(α,n)≤c}|→g(c)? Lean states this for all real c, where the page's limit is not restricted to continuity points. log n vanishes only at small n, which does not affect the limit. The page lists proof claims I did not assess, so the 'research open' status is not verified.
